text: Meet at least two of the three characteristic criteria for AP: ① Acute onset of persistent upper abdominal pain; ② Serum amylase and/or lipase activity at least three times above the upper limit of normal; ③ Imaging findings on CT, MRI, or abdominal ultrasonography.
sub_conditions: Acute onset of persistent upper abdominal pain
Serum amylase and/or lipase at least 3 times the upper limit of normal
Imaging findings consistent with AP on CT, MRI, or abdominal ultrasonography
At least two of the three above are met
needed_info: symptoms: abdominal pain onset and character

text: Meet the diagnostic criteria for hypertriglyceridemia-associated acute pancreatitis (HTG-AP): fulfill the AP diagnostic criteria and concurrent hypertriglyceridemia (serum triglycerides ≥11.3 mmol/L or 5.65-11.3 mmol/L with lactescent serum), with exclusion of other common causes of AP such as cholelithiasis and alcoholism.
sub_conditions: Serum triglycerides ≥11.3 mmol/L, or 5.65-11.3 mmol/L with lactescent serum
Other common causes of AP (e.g., cholelithiasis, alcoholism) excluded
needed_info: etiology workup: gallstones, alcohol use history

text: Admission within 72 hours of symptom onset.
sub_conditions: Time from symptom onset to admission ≤72 hours

text: Disease severity assessed as mild acute pancreatitis (MAP) within 48 hours of admission, defined by absence of organ dysfunction and absence of local or systemic complications.
sub_conditions: Classified as mild AP within 48 hours of admission
needed_info: imaging/clinical evidence of local or systemic complications

text: No history of allergy to microbiological agents.
sub_conditions: No history of allergy to microbiological agents

text: Concurrent biliary, alcoholic, or other etiologies of acute pancreatitis;
Acute exacerbation of chronic pancreatitis or pancreatic tumor;

Severe hypertriglyceridemia-associated acute pancreatitis: classified as moderately severe or severe AP per the Expert Consensus on the Diagnosis and Treatment of Hypertriglyceridemic Acute Pancreatitis.
Within 48 hours, meeting any one of: modified Marshall score ≥2, MCTSI score ≥4, APACHE II score ≥15, BISAP score ≥3, or Ranson score ≥3.
Severe hepatic or renal dysfunction (serum creatinine >177 μmol/L or ALT >150 U/L);
Active infection, malignancy, immunodeficiency, or requiring long-term use of immunosuppressants;

Use within 4 weeks prior to enrollment of antibiotics, probiotics, prebiotics, synbiotics, or other microbiological agents, as well as gastrointestinal motility drugs (e.g., domperidone, mosapride) or other medications that may significantly affect gut microbiota or gastrointestinal function.
sub_conditions: Other microbiological agent use within 4 weeks
Gastrointestinal motility drug use (e.g., domperidone, mosapride) within 4 weeks
Other medications significantly affecting gut microbiota or GI function within 4 weeks
needed_info: medication history within the last 4 weeks
